info.name: Healthcare Management API
info.description: Generated from the actual backend implementation in this workspace. This collection reflects the real Express routes, auth middleware, cookies, and Zod validation used by the server at http://localhost:5000.

request.description: Public registration endpoint. On success, the server sets accessToken, refreshToken, and better-auth.session_token cookies.

exec: pm.test("Response contains success and data", function () { pm.expect(response).to.have.property("success"); pm.expect(response).to.have.property("data"); });

request.description: This is the main app login. It sets cookies: accessToken, refreshToken, better-auth.session_token.
Requires auth. The server checks the Better Auth session cookie and the JWT accessToken cookie.
Reads refreshToken and better-auth.session_token cookies from the cookie jar. Returns new tokens.
Requires authenticated session; uses better-auth.session_token cookie.
Logs the user out and clears the accessToken, refreshToken, and better-auth.session_token cookies.
OTP-based verification flow using Better Auth plugin. A real OTP must be delivered to the email address.

exec: pm.test("Status code is accepted", function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Sends a password reset OTP to the email if the account exists and is verified.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200 or 404", function () { pm.expect([200, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Resets password using OTP. Requires a valid OTP that is actually generated and sent by the email verification plugin.

exec: pm.test("Status code is accepted", function () { pm.expect([200, 400, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Starts the social login flow.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200 or 302", function () { pm.expect([200, 302]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Updates current patient profile and related health data. A multer middleware also supports file upload fields named profilePhoto and medicalReports.
Creates an appointment for the authenticated patient. Requires a valid doctorId and scheduleId.
Returns appointments for the authenticated patient or doctor.
Updates appointment status; allowed user roles include PATIENT, DOCTOR, ADMIN, and SUPER_ADMIN.
Fetch a single appointment for the current user.
Admin-only route that returns all appointments.
Creates an appointment using a pay-later option.
Initiates payment for an appointment by id.
Creates slots between start and end dates/times.
List schedules with pagination and sorting.
Gets one schedule by id.
Updates existing schedule times.
Deletes a schedule record.
Links the authenticated doctor to schedule ids.
Returns the authenticated doctor's schedule records.
Admin/super-admin route for all doctor-schedule links.
Creates a specialty, with optional file upload via multer.
Lists specialties.
Hard deletes specialty by id; admin/super-admin route.
Public route to retrieve all reviews.
Creates a review attached to an appointment. Requires PATIENT role.
Returns reviews for the authenticated patient or doctor.
Admin-only list of prescriptions.
Gets prescriptions for the authenticated patient or doctor.
Creates a prescription for an appointment. Requires DOCTOR role.
Lists all admin and super-admin profiles.
Allows admin or super-admin to change a target user's status.
Only super-admin may change user roles, with checks enforced in AdminService.
Requires auth for SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, DOCTOR, or PATIENT.
RAG stats endpoint. This route is not protected.
Indexes doctor data for the RAG service.
Queries the retrieved medical documents.
No auth cookie should fail with 401.
